column1: # Stable persisted-place to reward-payload mappings, one tab-separated row:
# APPEND-ONLY (no-resets law). A reward claim stores only place_id, so every
# later boot derives the earned outcome from this row. The real boot guard binds
# production registrations to the ledger in both directions, and CI compares
# each complete row with the pull request base. Removing or changing any column
# would reinterpret progression that a released client already granted.
